# netbox_owner (Resource)

From the official NetBox documentation:

> An owner represents a user and/or user group(s) which can be assigned responsibility for NetBox objects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_group" "test" {
  name = "network-admins"
}

resource "netbox_user" "test" {
  username = "jdoe"
  password = "Abcdefghijkl1"
  active   = true
}

resource "netbox_owner_group" "test" {
  name = "Infrastructure Team"
}

resource "netbox_owner" "test" {
  name           = "Network Operations"
  description    = "Owner for network infrastructure objects"
  group_id       = netbox_owner_group.test.id
  user_group_ids = [netbox_group.test.id]
  user_ids       = [netbox_user.test.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `group_id` (Number)
- `user_group_ids` (Set of Number)
- `user_ids` (Set of Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
